description: Move a chat, roll, space, collection or space file into another space (a doc moves with update_doc_info). A sub-space moves with everything in it; a space can also go to the top of Personal or Team with to_top_level. Collections and files stay under their own Personal or Team. A move that changes who can open something (a roll or space going between Personal and Team, guests gaining or losing a space, a chat's roll following it) is refused until your human agrees: ask them, then call again with agreed: true.

agreed.description: true only once your human agreed to what the refusal named.

from_space_id.description: A file only: the space it is in now.

id.description: Its id from list_space (space_file_id for a file, collection_id for a collection).

to_top_level.description: A space only, instead of to_space_id.

name: move
title: Move
